description: This file defines the `absl::string_view` class, a lightweight, non-owning view into a string or character array, designed as a drop-in replacement for C++17's `std::string_view`. It includes constructors, member functions, comparison operators, and utility functions related to string views.

classes.name: absl::string_view
classes.description: A non-owning, lightweight view into a contiguous sequence of characters, providing string-like operations without copying or owning the data.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the first character.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator just beyond the last character.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in the view.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Alias for size().

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the view is empty.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses the character at index i without bounds checking.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses the character at index i with bounds checking.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns the first character.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns the last character.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying character array.

methods.name: remove_prefix
methods.description: Removes the first n characters from the view.

methods.name: remove_suffix
methods.description: Removes the last n characters from the view.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps this view with another.

methods.name: operator std::basic_string
methods.description: Converts the string_view to a std::basic_string.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies characters into a buffer.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns a substring view at a given position and length.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Lexicographically compares with another string_view.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a substring or character within the view.

methods.name: rfind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a substring or character.

methods.name: find_first_of
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of any character in a set.

methods.name: find_last_of
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of any character in a set.

methods.name: find_first_not_of
methods.description: Finds the first character not in a set.

methods.name: find_last_not_of
methods.description: Finds the last character not in a set.
